UnitStatement: equipment-extract is used with a generic TASK shell with no profile.
The example equipment-extract brief purpose is to extract equipment items from KTY-04-01 KA files.
ScopePath is a required brief field and must be the top-level execution root.
TaskSkill is a required brief field and must be equipment-extract.
AllowedWriteTargets is a required brief field and must be exactly {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_Aggregation/Equipment_Extract/.
RuntimeOverrides.KTY_PATH is required and must be an absolute path to the KTY folder containing KA files.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_ROOT is required and must be {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_Aggregation/Equipment_Extract/.
equipment-extract has no optional brief fields.
equipment-extract uses TaskProfile NONE and runs in generic TASK shell mode without a profile.
equipment-extract may read KA-*.md files under KTY_PATH.
equipment-extract may read _CONTEXT.md under KTY_PATH.
equipment-extract may read _REFERENCES.md under KTY_PATH.
equipment-extract must not read arbitrary files under ScopePath.
equipment-extract writes only {OUTPUT_ROOT}/{KTY_ID}_Equipment_Extract.md.
OUTPUT_ROOT must already exist because equipment-extract does not create it.
KTY_ID is derived from _CONTEXT.md or inferred from the folder name when _CONTEXT.md is unavailable.
One equipment-extract invocation processes one KTY folder.
The equipment-extract brief omits AllowedTools because the skill has no deterministic tool dependencies.
QA requires KTY_PATH to exist and contain at least one KA-*.md file or report FAILED_INPUTS.
QA requires OUTPUT_ROOT to exist before equipment-extract writes output.
QA requires every KA-*.md file in the KTY folder to be read or its absence explicitly reported.
QA requires {KTY_ID}_Equipment_Extract.md to be written to OUTPUT_ROOT.
QA requires the output file to contain title, metadata block, Equipment Table, Package Notes, and equipment count footer.
QA requires that no files in KTY_PATH are written or modified.
Every Equipment Table row must satisfy the source-traceability requirements.
The KA Source column must name the specific KA-*.md file from which the item was extracted.
An extracted equipment item must appear in the cited KA file text.
equipment-extract must not invent equipment items.
The Equipment Tag value must exactly match the source text or be No tag when the source states no tag.
Package Name must be a formal source name, a contextual name with (indicated), or N/A.
A run with any untraceable equipment row is invalid.
A KTY with zero physical equipment must still produce an output file.
A null-result output must contain an empty Equipment Table or a single explanatory row.
A null-result output must include Package Notes explaining why no equipment was found.
A null-result output must include an equipment count footer reading 0 with a parenthetical explanation.
Issue reporting must group missing KA files.
Issue reporting must group ambiguous tags.
Issue reporting must group scope boundary items.
Issue reporting must group TBD items.
Issue reporting must group package assignment uncertainty.
A clean equipment-extract run reports RUN_STATUS=OK.
A clean equipment-extract run reports the output file path.
A clean equipment-extract run reports the equipment count.
A clean equipment-extract run reports the list of KA files read.
A clean equipment-extract run reports no warnings or explicitly states that none were encountered.
equipment-extract extracts discrete physical equipment items from Knowledge Artifact files within a single DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder.
equipment-extract is compatible with Chirality TASK in generic shell mode with no profile.
equipment-extract produces a normalized source-traceable equipment register for a KTY.
equipment-extract is reasoning-first and applies extraction logic directly to KA markdown files.
TASK in generic shell mode with no profile is a suitable shell for equipment-extract.
ScopePath is a required input for equipment-extract.
AllowedWriteTargets is a required input for equipment-extract and must point to the Equipment_Extract output directory.
RuntimeOverrides.KTY_PATH is a required input for equipment-extract.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_ROOT is a required input for equipment-extract.
KTY_ID is derived at runtime from _CONTEXT.md or inferred from the folder name.
equipment-extract has no optional inputs.
KTY_PATH must be a valid directory path containing KA-*.md files.
OUTPUT_ROOT must be a pre-existing output directory for extract files.
equipment-extract reads all Knowledge Artifact KA-*.md files under KTY_PATH.
equipment-extract reads _CONTEXT.md for KTY identity metadata.
equipment-extract reads _REFERENCES.md for reference context.
equipment-extract must not read Scoping.md, _STATUS.md, files outside the KTY folder, or arbitrary ScopePath files.
equipment-extract writes only {RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_ROOT}/{KTY_ID}_Equipment_Extract.md.
equipment-extract requires OUTPUT_ROOT to preexist and does not create it.
equipment-extract declares no deterministic tools.
equipment-extract omits the allowed-tools frontmatter field.
equipment-extract disallows writing outside OUTPUT_ROOT.
equipment-extract disallows modification of any file in KTY_PATH.
equipment-extract disallows widening scope beyond the designated KTY folder.
Step 0 validates that KTY_PATH exists and is a directory; otherwise the run reports FAILED_INPUTS.
Step 0 validates that OUTPUT_ROOT exists; otherwise the run reports FAILED_INPUTS.
Step 1 reads _CONTEXT.md on a best-effort basis.
Step 1 extracts KTY ID, KTY name, parent Category ID, and parent Category name.
If _CONTEXT.md is missing or ambiguous, equipment-extract falls back to the folder name and records the fallback in Package Notes.
Step 2 lists all KA-*.md files in the KTY folder.
Step 2 orders the KA file read list by KA number.
Step 3 extracts every discrete physical equipment item from each KA file.
In-scope equipment includes vessels, separators, drums, columns, and towers.
In-scope equipment includes compressors, pumps, blowers, and fans.
In-scope equipment includes heat exchangers, coolers, heaters, reboilers, and condensers.
In-scope equipment includes tanks and storage vessels.
In-scope equipment includes filters, strainers, coalescers, and scrubbers.
In-scope equipment includes control valves, PSVs, ESDVs, shutdown valves, and blowdown valves.
In-scope equipment includes instruments, meters, and analyzers when they are named as discrete devices.
In-scope equipment includes motors and drivers when they are discrete tagged or named equipment.
In-scope equipment includes any physically instantiated discrete named or tagged device.
Virtual machines and software instances are out of scope for equipment extraction.
Buildings and structures are out of scope, but equipment housed within them remains in scope.
Documents, procedures, and specifications are out of scope for equipment extraction.
Non-physical items such as data points, software licenses, and network addresses are out of scope.
The Equipment Tag field records the exact source tag or No tag if unstated.
The Equipment Name field records the descriptive name as stated with key attributes in parentheses.
The Package Name field records a formal package name, a contextual package name with (indicated), or N/A.
The Notes field records sparing TBDs, conflicts, and scope notes.
The KA Source field records the KA file from which the item was extracted.
Step 4 combines all per-KA items into one ordered Equipment Table.
The Equipment Table columns are #, CAT, KTY, KA Source, Equipment Tag, Equipment Name, Package Name, and Notes.
Equipment Table rows are ordered by KA source and then by order of appearance within each KA.
Equipment Table row numbers are sequential starting at 1.
Package Notes address formal versus implied package or module assignments.
Package Notes address notable groupings or splits.
Package Notes address scope boundary ambiguities.
Package Notes address excluded items with rationale.
Package Notes address active conflicts or TBDs affecting equipment identification.
Package Notes address null-result explanations for KTYs with zero physical equipment.
The output title format is # Equipment Extract - {KTY_ID} {KTY Name}.
The output metadata block includes Category, Knowledge Type, Source KA files, and Extraction date.
The output file includes the assembled Equipment Table.
The output file includes Package Notes.
The output file includes an equipment count footer formatted as **{KTY_ID} Equipment Count: {N}**.
For zero-equipment KTYs, the table is empty or contains a single explanatory row.
For zero-equipment KTYs, the count footer reads 0 with a parenthetical explanation.
An informational inventory may include excluded items for traceability when clearly marked as excluded.
{KTY_ID}_Equipment_Extract.md is the output artifact written in OUTPUT_ROOT.
equipment-extract must never modify any file in KTY_PATH.
equipment-extract must only extract equipment explicitly mentioned in KA files.
equipment-extract must keep equipment tags verbatim and must not infer or construct them.
equipment-extract package assignments must be sourced, marked indicated, or N/A.
equipment-extract requires complete coverage of every KA-*.md file in the KTY folder.
equipment-extract must report missing KA files.
equipment-extract must produce an extract file explaining KTYs with zero physical equipment.
Every equipment-extract table row must cite the specific KA file from which it was extracted.
QA expects all KA files in the folder to be read or their absence reported.
QA expects no equipment item to appear unless it exists in the KA source text.
QA expects the output file to contain title, metadata, table, Package Notes, and count footer.
equipment-extract does not produce the consolidated Equipment_Master_List.csv.
Equipment_Master_List.csv assembly concatenates per-KTY extract tables after all extractions are complete.
The preferred tool order for equipment-extract is reasoning-first, with no deterministic tool ordering.
equipment-extract reads _CONTEXT.md, _REFERENCES.md, and all KA-*.md files in a KTY folder.
equipment-extract applies extraction logic directly to identify source-traceable equipment register items.
equipment-extract has no TASK-enforced deterministic tools.
equipment-extract declares no operational helper tools.
Reasoning governs preconditions, KTY context reading, KA enumeration, extraction, table assembly, Package Notes, and output composition.
TOOL_POLICY disallows writing outside OUTPUT_ROOT.
TOOL_POLICY disallows modifying any file in KTY_PATH.
TOOL_POLICY disallows widening scope beyond the designated KTY folder.
TOOL_POLICY disallows hidden reliance on tools outside the declared list unless the human expands AllowedTools.
TOOL_POLICY disallows writes outside the declared scope.
TOOL_POLICY write boundaries are limited to {RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_ROOT}/{KTY_ID}_Equipment_Extract.md.
No files in KTY_PATH may be written or modified.
